name: remove-spaces
description:
The spaces to remove (remove only).

kind: "all"; "left" and "right" (at that end only); "both" (at both ends); "extra" (runs collapsed to one space, none at the ends). "left", "right" and "both" keep the spaces inside.

Example: semkit read --text "  купить   диван " remove-spaces extra write -
-> купить диван

remove-spaces removes what the matcher finds from the working column.

options.name: --kind
options.description: "all"; "left" and "right" (at that end only); "both" (at both ends); "extra" (runs collapsed to one space, none at the ends). "left", "right" and "both" keep the spaces inside.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
